title: xs --progress=json event
description: One line of xs --progress=json output on stderr. Lines that do not start with "{" are diagnostics, not events.

oneOf.title: progress
oneOf.description: Periodic totals, emitted on every display tick.

files_total.description: Regular files planned so far. Grows while scanning.

bytes.description: Logical file bytes completed. On a push this follows receiver acknowledgments.

bytes_total.description: Logical file bytes planned so far.

files_seen.description: Source entries discovered by the scan.

wire_bytes.description: Bytes sent (push) or received (pull) on the connection, including compression and framing. Zero for local copies.

phase.description: What the transfer is doing now.

verified.description: Successful checksum checks; source and destination hashes each count once.

scanning.description: True while the source scan is still running.

dry_run.description: True for -n; counts describe the plan, and nothing is written.

oneOf.title: file
oneOf.description: One transferred regular file (including clones and hard-link members), emitted after the destination operation succeeds, or once per planned file in a dry run.

path.description: Transfer-relative path. Valid UTF-8 is kept; control bytes are JSON-escaped, and invalid bytes appear as the Unicode code points of their byte values.

path_bytes_hex.description: The exact path bytes, hex encoded. Use this when names are not UTF-8.

code.description: The itemize change code, as printed by -i.

bytes.description: File-content bytes transferred (literal data). Zero for clones and dry runs; only the tail for a resumed file.

dry_run.description: True for -n; counts describe the plan, and nothing is written.

oneOf.title: complete
oneOf.description: Final totals, emitted once at the end. Always the last record.

files_total.description: Regular files planned so far. Grows while scanning.

bytes.description: Logical file bytes completed. On a push this follows receiver acknowledgments.

bytes_total.description: Logical file bytes planned so far.

files_seen.description: Source entries discovered by the scan.

wire_bytes.description: Bytes sent (push) or received (pull) on the connection, including compression and framing. Zero for local copies.

verified.description: Successful checksum checks; source and destination hashes each count once.

scanning.description: True while the source scan is still running.

dry_run.description: True for -n; counts describe the plan, and nothing is written.

success.description: True only if the transfer finished with exit status 0.

exit_code.description: The process exit status, or null if cleanup began before a fatal status was known.
